title: Assistant
subtitle: Code 92 · your workspace copilot
welcomeBody: Ask about your products, find knowledge, or ask me to get work done in your workspace.

suggestions.help: What can I do in this platform?

placeholder: Ask a question or describe a task…
inputHint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
permissions: Actions use your permissions. Completed actions appear in the conversation. Chat history lasts until you reload or start a new chat.

errors.notConfigured: The assistant is not connected yet. An administrator can configure its provider, model and API key in Settings.
errors.forbidden: Your session is unavailable or you do not have access. Sign in again to continue.
errors.invalid: This conversation could not be submitted. Try a shorter message or start a new chat.
errors.busy: Another assistant request is already running. Wait for it to finish.
errors.rateLimited: The model provider is busy. Try again in a moment. Any completed actions above remain saved.
errors.providerError: The model provider could not finish this request. Any completed actions above remain saved.
errors.timeout: This request took too long. Check the workspace before repeating an action; it may already have been saved.
errors.stepLimit: The assistant reached its action limit. Review the results above and send a smaller follow-up request.
errors.generic: The request was interrupted. Check the workspace before repeating an action; it may already have been saved.

setup.title: Workspace assistant
setup.intro: Connect an OpenAI-compatible provider so the assistant can answer platform questions and perform tasks for members.
setup.urlHint: Use a public HTTPS API base, including its prefix (for example, /v1). Do not include /chat/completions. Choose a model with function calling. Image attachments also require vision support.
setup.keySaved: Saved key — leave blank to keep it
setup.keyHint: Keys are encrypted and never shown again. Enter a new key when changing the provider URL.
setup.saved: Assistant settings saved. They apply to the next conversation request.
setup.testOk: The saved provider and model responded successfully.
setup.cleared: Saved settings cleared. Any server-configured provider is now used.
setup.testHint: The test uses the saved settings and makes one small model call without workspace data or actions.

errors.forbidden: Only active administrators can manage assistant settings.
errors.invalid: Enter a valid public HTTPS API base URL and model.
errors.keyRequired: Enter an API key for this provider URL.
errors.unavailable: Assistant setup storage is unavailable. Check the server configuration and database migration.
errors.conflict: Another administrator changed these settings. Reload and try again.
errors.testFailed: The provider test failed. Check the saved API URL, model and key, then try again.

attachments.hint: Up to 3 files · 2 MB total. Images, PDF text, TXT, MD, CSV, JSON or YAML. Images require a vision-capable model.

errors.fileSize: Choose a non-empty file smaller than 2 MB.
errors.fileTotalSize: Attachments must total 2 MB or less.
errors.fileCount: Attach up to 3 files per message.
errors.fileType: Use PNG, JPG, WebP, PDF or a text file (TXT, MD, CSV, JSON, YAML).
errors.fileUnreadable: This file could not be read. Use a valid image, an unlocked PDF or a UTF-8 text file.
errors.fileNoText: No readable text was found. For a scanned PDF, attach a screenshot instead.
errors.forbidden: Sign in again to attach files.
errors.busy: A file is already being processed. Try again shortly.
errors.generic: The file could not be attached. Try selecting it again.
